/ap/suppliers/[id].title: Supplier account
/ap/suppliers/[id].summary: Review this supplier's outstanding balance, open bills and payment profile.
tasks: Check the supplier identity and account status before using its balance.
Open bills and compare unpaid amounts with supplier statements and recorded payments.
Review contact and payment details before preparing a payment; investigate discrepancies in the source bill.

/assets/register/[id].title: Asset record
/assets/register/[id].summary: Inspect an asset's acquisition details and custody history.
tasks: Review the asset identity, cost, acquisition date and assigned accounts.
Read Details and the Custody timeline to establish who holds the asset.
Use only the lifecycle actions offered for the asset's current state and your role; verify their audit entries afterwards.

/distribution/trips/[id].title: Delivery trip
/distribution/trips/[id].summary: Review a delivery trip's stops, route legs, costs and activity.
tasks: Confirm the trip identity, vehicle, route and current status in Trip Summary.
Inspect route legs and cost lines before recording operational progress.
Read Activity and Audit before retrying a dispatch or close action; verify the resulting state in this trip.

/docs/[type]/[id]/edit.title: Edit document
/docs/[type]/[id]/edit.summary: Edit the selected document using its available draft fields.
tasks: Confirm the document number, type and state before editing.
Review parties, dates, warehouse and product or accounting lines in the editor.
Resolve validation messages, review totals and save deliberately; posted documents require the supported correction process.

/docs/[type]/[id].title: Document record
/docs/[type]/[id].summary: Review the selected document's lines, status, linked records and audit evidence.
tasks: Confirm the document type, number, party and current status.
Inspect product or accounting lines, taxes, attachments and linked source documents using the available tabs.
Use only the actions offered for this state; submission, approval, posting and fiscal signing have different effects.
Review history and source links before retrying a payment, posting or fiscal action.

/docs/[type]/new.title: Create document
/docs/[type]/new.summary: Prepare the selected type of document without posting it through the tutorial.
tasks: Choose the correct party and source references in the wizard.
Review the required dates, location and currency fields for this document type.
Add and verify product or accounting lines, units, quantities, prices and tax as applicable.
Review validation and totals, then use the offered save action deliberately; the guide never submits the document.

/docs/[type].title: Document list
/docs/[type].summary: Find a document of the selected type and continue it in the correct state.
tasks: Search by document number, party or reference and apply the available status and date filters.
Check the document type, total, currency and status before opening a row.
Open the intended document or use New to prepare one when your role allows it.

/docs/grn/[id].title: Goods receipt record
/docs/grn/[id].summary: Verify a goods receipt's source, received quantities, stock and audit evidence.
tasks: Confirm supplier, source purchase order and receiving warehouse.
Inspect receipt lines, units, lot and quality evidence where required.
Review tax and activity before using the permitted receipt action; confirm posted stock in the linked inventory records.

/docs/grn/new.title: Create goods receipt
/docs/grn/new.summary: Prepare receipt quantities against the correct supplier and purchase order.
tasks: Select the source purchase order or supplier using the receipt workflow.
Confirm the receiving warehouse, date, quantities and units actually received.
Complete lot, measurement and quality information required by this template.
Review discrepancies and validation before saving or posting deliberately.

/finance/fixed-assets.title: Fixed assets workspace
/finance/fixed-assets.summary: Review asset cost, depreciation runs and lifecycle actions from finance.
tasks: Read asset count, active assets and total cost in the selected scope.
Inspect depreciation runs and compare the proposed charge with asset records and periods.
Use Lifecycle Actions for the supported accounting operation, then inspect its source journal.

/franchise/commission/runs/[id].title: Commission run record
/franchise/commission/runs/[id].summary: Review the period, outlet lines and state of a franchise commission run.
tasks: Confirm the run identity, period and header state.
Inspect outlet lines and calculated commission evidence before accepting the run.
Use the actions offered for your role and verify the updated state; franchise SKU commissions are separate from employee payroll earnings.

/franchise/outlets/[id].title: Franchise outlet record
/franchise/outlets/[id].summary: Review an outlet's operational profile, location and product performance.
tasks: Confirm the outlet identity, organisation and current operating state.
Inspect performance and Top products for the displayed period.
Review GPS coordinates and the available operational tabs; save changes only with the required outlet permission.

/inbox.title: Work inbox
/inbox.summary: Prioritise pending approvals, operational alerts and assigned tasks.
tasks: Review Pending approvals for decisions waiting on your role.
Open an alert's source record before attempting a corrective action.
Inspect assigned Tasks and update a task only when the underlying work is complete.

/inventory/receipts/[id].title: Inventory receipt record
/inventory/receipts/[id].summary: Inspect a receipt's supplier, stock lines, tax and posting history.
tasks: Confirm the receipt identity, supplier, warehouse and current state.
Review Receipt Lines for actual received quantities, units and traceability evidence.
Compare Tax and Activity and Audit with the source purchase before performing the allowed posting action.

/inventory/stock.title: Stock workspace
/inventory/stock.summary: Review stock at the current product and warehouse scope.
tasks: Search for the product and select the relevant warehouse or location.
Compare on-hand, reserved and available quantities using the units shown.
Open movements or a source receipt to investigate a difference before preparing an adjustment.

/inventory/stock-levels/[id].title: Stock location record
/inventory/stock-levels/[id].summary: Inspect a product's stock at one location and compare other locations.
tasks: Confirm the selected SKU, location and unit before reading the stock balance.
Review Stock at this location, including reserved and available quantities.
Compare Same SKU at other locations; use the transfer workflow for a physical move rather than editing the balance.

/manufacturing/boms/[id].title: BOM record
/manufacturing/boms/[id].summary: Review output, components and routing for the selected BOM revision.
tasks: Check the finished product, batch output, version and lifecycle.
Review component products, quantities, units, stores and scrap in Components.
Inspect Routing; route changes save immediately, so change it only deliberately.
Use revision governance for controlled production changes.

/manufacturing/boms/new.title: New BOM
/manufacturing/boms/new.summary: Define a BOM's product and batch output, then add components on its record.
tasks: Enter a name and select the correct product from the catalogue.
Set the batch quantity and output unit, then review the production method.
Choose an output warehouse or leave it to the work order.
Review the batch preview and create deliberately; this does not post stock.

/manufacturing/subcontracting/orders/[id.title: Subcontract order record
/manufacturing/subcontracting/orders/[id.summary: Trace a subcontract order through inputs, outputs, transport and cost evidence.
tasks: Confirm the processor, product, quantities and current order state.
Inspect Outbound trip and Lines for stock sent out and output expected back.
Review the Batch cost chain, fee-to-COGS variance and Yield batches before settlement.
Use the permitted receipt or completion action only after matching the physical and cost evidence.

/manufacturing/subcontracting/orders.title: Subcontract orders
/manufacturing/subcontracting/orders.summary: Locate subcontract production orders and inspect processor, progress and material linkage.
tasks: Filter or search for the intended subcontract order.
Compare processor, product and status before opening its record.
Create a new order only when stock, processing terms and your permissions support the task.

/manufacturing/work-orders/[id].title: Production work order
/manufacturing/work-orders/[id].summary: Prepare and execute this production order using its saved recipe and measurement controls.
tasks: Confirm the product, warehouse, recipe snapshot and lifecycle before releasing or starting.
Review Production steps and Materials in the warehouse; investigate shortages before consumption.
Record actual production and trusted measurement evidence where required; complete only when the physical batch is ready.
Review Production reconciliation for immutable material, yield and cost evidence after completion.

/manufacturing/yield/[id].title: Yield record
/manufacturing/yield/[id].summary: Inspect a production yield record's source batch, output lines and history.
tasks: Confirm source batch, processor or work order and the units in Yield Record Summary.
Compare Output lines with measured input and the expected production basis.
Review Activity and Audit and linked inventory evidence before using any correction workflow.

/master/products/[id]/attributes.title: Product attributes
/master/products/[id]/attributes.summary: Review attribute definitions and variants for the selected product.
tasks: Confirm the base product and its existing attribute definitions.
Inspect Variants using attributes before changing a shared attribute.
Save only the allowed catalogue change and check the affected variants afterwards.

/master/products/[id]/packaging.title: Product packaging
/master/products/[id]/packaging.summary: Inspect unit conversions and packaging for this product.
tasks: Confirm the base SKU and base unit.
Review each UOM conversion and its factor; distinguish packs, sale units and measured quantities.
Save an authorised conversion change and verify the resulting quantities in a representative draft document.

/master/products/[id].title: Product record
/master/products/[id].summary: Review a product's identity, classification, pricing and validations.
tasks: Confirm product code, name, base unit and current status.
Inspect Classification and Pricing along with the product's price-tag assignments.
Resolve Validations and open the relevant variants, attributes or packaging workspace before changing shared catalogue data.

/master/products/[id]/pricing.title: Product pricing
/master/products/[id]/pricing.summary: Review a product's prices, tiers and validation across price lists.
tasks: Confirm SKU, unit, currency and the effective price basis.
Inspect Validations and Compare price lists before reviewing quantity tiers.
Save only authorised prices or assignments; verify the effective price in the relevant customer draft.

/master/products/[id]/variants.title: Product variants
/master/products/[id]/variants.summary: Inspect variants associated with the selected base product.
tasks: Confirm the base product and variant attribute combinations.
Open the intended variant and compare its code, unit and status.
Create or edit variants only through the available catalogue actions and check for duplicate combinations.

/onboarding.title: Organisation setup
/onboarding.summary: Complete the ERP setup checklist in dependency order.
tasks: Confirm the active organisation and the setup checklist's remaining work.
Complete master data, financial mappings and access setup using the linked screens.
Return to the checklist to verify completion and test a representative operational draft before go-live.

/payroll/employees/[id].title: Employee record
/payroll/employees/[id].summary: Review an employee's employment, statutory and payout readiness.
tasks: Confirm the employee identity and employment state.
Inspect Employment profile and Statutory context using the organisation's approved HR information.
Review Bank and payout readiness before a pay run; save sensitive changes only with the required role.

/payroll/leave/balances.title: Leave balances
/payroll/leave/balances.summary: Review employees' available leave by policy and period.
tasks: Select the applicable employee or scope offered by the page.
Compare entitlement, taken leave and remaining balance under the relevant policy.
Investigate approved leave requests and policy settings before adjusting a balance.

/payroll/leave/calendar.title: Leave calendar
/payroll/leave/calendar.summary: Review approved leave and staffing impact for the selected month.
tasks: Choose the relevant calendar month and team scope.
Inspect approved leaves on the calendar and All leaves this month.
Open a source request for details; a calendar review does not approve or cancel leave.

/payroll/leave/policies.title: Leave policies
/payroll/leave/policies.summary: Configure leave entitlement and approval policy using approved HR rules.
tasks: Review the existing leave types and entitlement policy.
Inspect the fields and effective scope before editing a policy.
Save an authorised change and verify its effect on a representative employee's balance and request.

/payroll/leave/requests.title: Leave requests
/payroll/leave/requests.summary: Review employee leave requests and their approval state.
tasks: Filter Requests to the employee, period or status relevant to your role.
Open a request and compare dates, leave type, balance and supporting details.
Approve or reject only through the offered workflow and verify the employee's resulting leave state.

/payroll/pay-runs/[id].title: Payroll run record
/payroll/pay-runs/[id].summary: Inspect a pay run's period, employee lines and payroll totals.
tasks: Confirm the run period, scope and current state in Summary.
Review employee Lines and investigate unexpected earnings, deductions or payout readiness.
Use calculation, approval or posting only as permitted by the current state; inspect resulting payroll and accounting evidence.

/pricing/price-lists/[id].title: Price list record
/pricing/price-lists/[id].summary: Review prices and the supported pricing engine for this list.
tasks: Confirm list identity, currency and applicable customer or zone scope.
Inspect product prices, units, effective dates and available engine settings.
Review changes before saving; verify the effective price on a representative customer draft.

/pricing/workspace/packs.title: Product pack configuration
/pricing/workspace/packs.summary: Review product units and packaging in the catalogue workspace.
tasks: Open the intended product and review its base unit.
Inspect Packaging and UOM conversions before changing pack factors.
Verify the resulting quantities in an operational draft before relying on a new conversion.

/projects/[id].title: Project record
/projects/[id].summary: Review a project's budget, time and linked source costs.
tasks: Confirm the project identity, state and Budget.
Compare Timesheet hours, Linked source value and Recorded labor estimate.
Use Planning estimate vs budget to investigate differences; estimates and linked posted values have different bases.

/purchasing/cash-weight-audit/override/[.title: Weight correction request
/purchasing/cash-weight-audit/override/[.summary: Review a requested weight correction against its original measurement evidence.
tasks: Confirm the source receipt or batch and the requester's reason.
Compare the values in Weight comparison with retained physical and measurement evidence.
Use Decision only with the authorised review role; verify the resulting record and audit entry.

/purchasing/goods-receipt.title: Goods receipts
/purchasing/goods-receipt.summary: Find goods receipts and verify purchase linkage before receiving stock.
tasks: Search Goods Receipt Notes by supplier, source reference or document number.
Check receipt status, warehouse, quantities and related purchase order.
Open the intended receipt or prepare one using the offered receiving workflow.

/purchasing/orders/[id].title: Purchase order record
/purchasing/orders/[id].summary: Trace a purchase order's requested quantities, receipts, bills and additional costs.
tasks: Confirm supplier, currency, amounts and current state in Purchase Order Summary.
Compare Goods receipts, Linked supplier bills and Purchase vs received quantities.
Inspect Additional costs before deciding whether to receive, match, amend or close through the permitted action.

/purchasing/purchase-orders.title: Purchase orders workspace
/purchasing/purchase-orders.summary: Find and inspect supplier purchase orders.
tasks: Search or filter the relevant supplier orders.
Compare quantities, amounts and status before opening a record.
Review receipt and supplier-bill linkage in the selected order before continuing procurement.

/purchasing/supplier-invoices.title: Supplier invoices
/purchasing/supplier-invoices.summary: Find supplier bills and review their purchase and receipt linkage.
tasks: Search Supplier Invoices for the supplier reference or bill number.
Check amount, currency, matching state and posting status.
Open the intended bill, resolve match exceptions and continue only with the permitted posting or payment action.

/reports/batch-costing.title: Batch costing report
/reports/batch-costing.summary: Review production costs by batch without combining unlike units.
tasks: Choose the Filters for period and the production scope offered by the page.
Run the report deliberately and inspect Cost breakdown by batch.
Compare material, processing and other cost components with source batches; export only after checking the report basis.

/reports/commission-reconciliation.title: Commission reconciliation
/reports/commission-reconciliation.summary: Compare commission calculations with their run and source evidence.
tasks: Select the relevant run and scope in Run reconciliation.
Load the comparison deliberately and inspect differences.
Investigate source pricing, outlet assignments and run state before correcting a discrepancy.

/reports/manufacturing/[reportId].title: Manufacturing report
/reports/manufacturing/[reportId].summary: Review this manufacturing report's filters, basis, units and production evidence.
tasks: Select the period and required recipe, work order or warehouse scope offered for this report.
Run the report deliberately and read its basis and warnings.
Inspect source quantities and costs without combining different units; export only after checking applied filters.

/reports/operations/[reportId].title: Operations report
/reports/operations/[reportId].summary: Review this operational report using its declared source basis and filters.
tasks: Choose the period and operational scope offered by this report.
Load the result deliberately and inspect warnings and missing source evidence.
Open source records for differences before exporting or saving a report snapshot.

/sales/customers/[id].title: Customer account
/sales/customers/[id].summary: Review the selected customer's credit, invoices, payments and account details.
tasks: Confirm the customer identity, credit limit, available credit and payment terms.
Open Orders, Invoices, Payments, Credit or Ledger to investigate the account using the available tabs.
Review the account profile before creating a new order; check existing payments before recording a collection.

/sales/orders/franchise-inbound/[outletO.title: Franchise inbound order
/sales/orders/franchise-inbound/[outletO.summary: Review an outlet purchase request before accepting it as a franchise sales order.
tasks: Confirm the requesting outlet, source request and status in Summary.
Read Notes and compare requested product Lines, units and prices.
Use the supported order action only after resolving matching or availability issues; verify linkage to the source request.

/sales/orders/franchise-inbound/new.title: Create franchise order
/sales/orders/franchise-inbound/new.summary: Prepare an order for the correct franchise outlet and product scope.
tasks: Choose the Franchise outlet and confirm the intended destination.
Select Products and review quantities, units and effective prices.
Check Order summary and validation before saving or submitting deliberately.

/settings/customization.title: ERP customisation
/settings/customization.summary: Open the available customisation workspace for modules, workflows or dashboards.
tasks: Choose the configuration area relevant to the requested change.
Review the current configuration and its organisation scope.
Save authorised changes and verify the affected workspace without changing role permissions through navigation.

/settings/products/packaging-defaults.title: Packaging setup
/settings/products/packaging-defaults.summary: Maintain product packaging through the supported product catalogue workspace.
tasks: Open the intended product from the catalogue.
Review base unit and Packaging conversions before editing pack factors.
Verify a representative draft after saving an authorised conversion change.

/treasury/payment-runs/[id].title: Payment run record
/treasury/payment-runs/[id].summary: Inspect a payment run's header, bills and settlement state.
tasks: Confirm bank account, currency, period and current state in Header.
Review Run lines for duplicate bills, due amounts and payment references.
Use the permitted export or posting action deliberately; generating a file or recording a payment does not itself confirm a bank transfer.

/tutorial/[chapterId]/[guideId].title: ERP task guide
/tutorial/[chapterId]/[guideId].summary: Read a task's prerequisites, instructions and related working screen.
tasks: Review the guide title, objective and numbered instructions.
Follow the working-screen link for this task and launch its interactive Help.
Use related guides for the next workflow and confirm your role has the required access.

/tutorial/[chapterId].title: ERP module guides
/tutorial/[chapterId].summary: Find the task guide for this ERP module.
tasks: Search or browse the module's available tasks.
Read the task outcome and open the relevant guide.
Open its working ERP screen and use Help for a walkthrough of its visible controls.

/warehouse/cycle-counts/[id].title: Cycle count record
/warehouse/cycle-counts/[id].summary: Review and reconcile a warehouse count's expected and measured quantities.
tasks: Confirm warehouse, count scope and current state.
Inspect Count lines, units and recorded quantities; investigate differences against physical stock.
Submit or post adjustments only through the supported count workflow and verify resulting inventory movements.

/warehouse/dispatch-returns/[id].title: Dispatch return record
/warehouse/dispatch-returns/[id].summary: Verify returned delivery quantities before receiving them back into stock.
tasks: Confirm the source dispatch, returning party and receiving store in Receipt.
Inspect Lines and enter only the quantities and units physically returned.
Review Confirm quantity and post to stock; posting is a real inventory action that requires your explicit confirmation.

/warehouse/pick-pack/[id].title: Pick and pack task
/warehouse/pick-pack/[id].summary: Fulfil the assigned order from the correct warehouse and preserve shortage evidence.
tasks: Confirm Fulfilment warehouse and inspect the Picklist quantities and units.
If Stock is in another site, follow a transfer or authorised source change rather than treating it as local stock.
Review Pack details and the Dispatch handoff; record actual quantities before completing the permitted task.

/warehouse/putaway/[id].title: Putaway task
/warehouse/putaway/[id].summary: Allocate received inventory to the correct warehouse bins.
tasks: Confirm the task's source receipt, product, warehouse and remaining quantity.
Review Allocate to bins and the permitted destination locations.
Confirm actual allocation deliberately and verify the task balance and inventory location afterwards.

/warehouse/transfers/[id].title: Stock transfer record
/warehouse/transfers/[id].summary: Review a stock move between its source and destination warehouses.
tasks: Confirm source, destination, date and state in Header.
Inspect Lines for products, quantities and units before moving stock.
Read Activity before dispatching or receiving through the permitted transfer workflow; verify both location balances.

/reports.title: Report Library
/reports.summary: Find available reports, review their scope and open saved views, schedules or export history.
tasks: Search the report library by report name or topic to find the report you need. Clear the search to restore the available reports.
Review the report description and category before opening it. Set dates and filters on the report screen before relying on its results.
Use Saved Views to reopen saved report configurations. Open Scheduled and Exports to review existing report schedules and export history.

/purchasing/requests/[id]/review.title: Match and manually approve requisition items
/purchasing/requests/[id]/review.summary: Review each requested item, its approved quantity and supplier price before allocating the remaining requirement to draft POs.
tasks: Open Purchase Requests, create or open the requisition, then choose Review items / create purchase orders. An ERP requisition form is saved as a draft; item decisions start pending.

Match each requested description to a company product using name, product code, SKU or barcode. Confirm the requested unit; configured pack conversions are frozen when the review is saved. Resolve missing conversions before approving.
For each line, manually choose Approve item, Reject item or Leave pending. Enter an approved quantity no greater than the requested quantity. A matched product is not automatically approved.

Review the last active supplier and price from a completed bill or receipt, including its date, unit and currency. Drafts do not establish the default. If there is no purchase history, enter supplier and price explicitly.

Change supplier when required. The old supplier's price is cleared and the selected supplier's purchase history is suggested; enter a reviewed price when none exists. Check the company tax code and whether the price includes or excludes tax.
Choose Save manual item review. Open the requisition document to submit it and complete the required approval. Item review does not automatically approve a PO.

Return to the review, refresh status and enter Order now quantities within the approved remainder. Create draft purchase orders groups lines by supplier, currency and tax basis. Repeated retries must not create another order.
Open the linked POs and review their supplier, quantities, prices and delivery information. Already ordered item decisions are frozen; unallocated pending items may be approved later.

For a cancelled order, cancel or reverse its downstream receipts and bills first, then use Release cancelled PO quantities once. Review any replacement supplier before creating a new PO. Cancellation in ERP does not itself confirm cancellation with the supplier.

/settings/company-email.title: Set up company SendGrid email
/settings/company-email.summary: Configure a company-owned or OdaFlow-managed SendGrid sender, verify domain ownership and track approved PO delivery.
tasks: A company administrator opens Settings > Company email. Check the active company before entering sender or account details; this setup is for purchase-order emails.

Choose Company-owned SendGrid or OdaFlow-managed SendGrid. For a company-owned account, enter its API key with Mail Send and domain-authentication read access. The server must have integration-secret encryption configured. Keys are encrypted and never returned to the form; leave the key blank to retain a saved key.
For managed sending, the OdaFlow operator authenticates the company's domain in the managed account. No platform API key is shown to the company, and the company must still prove DNS ownership.
Enter the company sender name, From email and Reply-To address. Save sender settings. Saving changes disables sending until verification succeeds again.
In the selected SendGrid account, open Settings > Sender Authentication, authenticate the exact From domain and install SendGrid's DNS records with the authorised DNS administrator.

Also install the ERP company ownership TXT record shown on this page: use the exact displayed name and value. Each company has its own ownership proof; do not copy another company's sender or DNS token.

After DNS propagation, choose Verify domain and enable sending. Both ownership proof and the authenticated SendGrid domain must pass. Resolve credentials, permissions or DNS errors rather than bypassing verification.

Optionally configure the signed Event Webhook using the displayed callback URL and its public verification key, with Delivered, Bounce and Dropped events. A managed parent account can use the shared callback. Without events, Accepted by provider must not be described as Delivered.
Return to an approved test PO, review its intended recipient and PDF, and have the authorised operator perform a controlled delivery test. Company email setup does not itself send any supplier email.

/purchasing/requests.title: Match and manually approve requisition items
/purchasing/requests.summary: Review each requested item, its approved quantity and supplier price before allocating the remaining requirement to draft POs.
tasks: Open Purchase Requests, create or open the requisition, then choose Review items / create purchase orders. An ERP requisition form is saved as a draft; item decisions start pending.

Match each requested description to a company product using name, product code, SKU or barcode. Confirm the requested unit; configured pack conversions are frozen when the review is saved. Resolve missing conversions before approving.
For each line, manually choose Approve item, Reject item or Leave pending. Enter an approved quantity no greater than the requested quantity. A matched product is not automatically approved.

Review the last active supplier and price from a completed bill or receipt, including its date, unit and currency. Drafts do not establish the default. If there is no purchase history, enter supplier and price explicitly.

Change supplier when required. The old supplier's price is cleared and the selected supplier's purchase history is suggested; enter a reviewed price when none exists. Check the company tax code and whether the price includes or excludes tax.
Choose Save manual item review. Open the requisition document to submit it and complete the required approval. Item review does not automatically approve a PO.

Return to the review, refresh status and enter Order now quantities within the approved remainder. Create draft purchase orders groups lines by supplier, currency and tax basis. Repeated retries must not create another order.
Open the linked POs and review their supplier, quantities, prices and delivery information. Already ordered item decisions are frozen; unallocated pending items may be approved later.

For a cancelled order, cancel or reverse its downstream receipts and bills first, then use Release cancelled PO quantities once. Review any replacement supplier before creating a new PO. Cancellation in ERP does not itself confirm cancellation with the supplier.

/purchasing/orders.title: Approve and send a purchase order
/purchasing/orders.summary: Review the PO, complete its approval and email an immutable PDF through the company's verified sender, with delivery tracking.
tasks: Open a linked draft PO from the requisition review or Purchasing > Purchase orders. Check supplier, product units, quantities, price, currency, tax and delivery instructions; make permitted changes while it is a draft.

Submit the PO for approval. An authorised approver can approve without sending, or use Approve & send to supplier in Supplier email delivery. Existing approval rules and maker-checker controls still apply.
Before sending, check the displayed supplier, To address, verified company From address and printable PO PDF. Confirm the review checkbox. An already approved PO offers Send to supplier.
If the company sender is not verified, open Settings > Company email and complete its account and DNS setup. Add the supplier's email to the supplier record if it is missing.

Approve & send queues the frozen PDF only when approval succeeds. If the recipient, sender or PO changes after review, refresh delivery status and review again. Sending does not receive stock, post a bill or pay the supplier.

Refresh delivery status. Queued waits for the worker; Accepted by provider is not confirmed delivery. Delivered or Bounced requires signed SendGrid events. Failed needs review of settings or source data.
For Unknown, check SendGrid activity before any resend: the provider may already have accepted the message. Do not make another PO or send blindly after a timeout.

For an accepted or delivered PO, an authorised user may enter a resend reason, review again and choose Resend same approved PO. It retains the original recipient and PDF, even if the supplier contact later changes.

Do not send the same purchasing commitment to another supplier. Agree cancellation with the supplier and use the controlled cancellation/replacement process; retain the audit trail and linked requisition quantities.
When goods arrive, create the linked GRN and record actual quantities, lots and QC. Match and post the supplier bill separately, then settle approved AP balances through finance.
